ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Serv-U Process Pattern
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious process pattern which could be a sign of an exploited Serv-U service

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\Serv\\-U\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\forfiles\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\scriptrunner\\\.exe$")))
